description: Initial SF1 frontier batch policy. Balanced by namespace and by syntactic proof shape, excludes all consumed theorem sets, reserves holdout buckets for the two known-live surfaces (Multiset, Set.Finite) and a general frontier bucket. Deterministic.

catalog_sources.description: Stage (a) --from-artifacts universe: the discovered Mathlib theorem catalog plus every theorem this project has evaluated. Entries may be directories (recursively scanned for *.json/*.jsonl/*.txt), glob patterns, or files. key_hints + dotted-decl-name dict-key/value harvesting (sf1_common) extract names; the dotted regex keeps tactic strings out. Missing paths are skipped, never an error. The per-theorem eval surfaces use the `full_name` key under a `per_theorem` list; discovered_theorems.json is a list of {file_path, full_name, ...}.

exclude_consumed_surfaces.description: Stage (b) consumed set: every theorem a prior experiment actually TARGETED. These live in the routing theorem-set files (project/evolve/routing/*_theorem_sets.json, keyed by full_name) and the win/label/pool artifacts under project/data, plus the curated theorem sets defined as string literals in tasks.py. Frontier = catalog - consumed = discovered/evaluated theorems not yet targeted by any experiment. The NS24 router config (ns24_router.json) is NOT matched by these globs and is never read. project/data is scanned recursively for json/jsonl/txt; missing paths are skipped (recorded in the ledger), never an error.

holdout_buckets.description: Reserved buckets so SF1 always re-measures the two known-live surfaces plus a general open frontier. Holdout theorems are drawn separately from the balanced body and are never excluded by consumed-surface filtering when flagged as holdout-regression checks.

buckets.name: multiset_holdout
buckets.purpose: weak-base-policy structural surface; WX3 oracle regression guard

buckets.name: set_finite_holdout
buckets.purpose: strong-base-policy surface; MX2 narrow aesop regression guard

buckets.name: general_frontier
buckets.purpose: unbiased open frontier; surfaces new candidate families

notes: SF1 batches are the unit of comparison; deltas are always measured beyond the rc1 control arm, never beyond raw.
Seed 1729 fixes both the namespace round-robin order and the within-bucket sampling so the same traced cache reproduces an identical batch.
GENERAL_FRONTIER is a virtual namespace meaning 'any namespace not otherwise listed'.
